# cDot

> cDot is the blockchain network built for secure, private, and instant payments, designed for
> private payments, verified identity, programmable money and autonomous agents. Built by
> Certonymity Ltd (London, UK).

Rather than forcing everything onto a single chain, cDot is a family of purpose-built blockchains,
each engineered for what it does best: identity, stablecoin settlement, and trading, interoperating
as one trusted network.

Mission: provide the settlement layer for value exchanged between people, businesses, and machines.
cDot uses cryptographic avatars of verified real identities to keep transactions both private and
safe, with invisible on- and off-ramping allowing anyone to benefit from the speed and low cost of
stablecoins.

The problem: stablecoins enable instant, borderless, programmable transactions, but today's
blockchains aren't designed for them. Existing systems are either fully general or optimized for
trading, and none treat identity as a first-class primitive. As an alternative to traditional
finance's invasive identity checks, cryptographic proof-of-human alone hits a ceiling when it comes
to payments and regulation. This gap becomes critical when AI agents transact on behalf of humans
and businesses: without native identity, agents cannot be held accountable, and their payments
cannot be trusted or audited. Created by the team behind c.Email (https://c.email/), cDot uses
cryptographic avatars of verified real identities to provide anonymity by default and accountability
when necessary. Payments at scale don't just need speed and low cost - they must be able to verify
who or what is on each side of a transaction, and no single general-purpose chain can serve both of
these purposes.

The network (three chains, interoperable by design):

1. C-Layer - identity and asset recovery chain: a purpose-built identity chain for people,
   businesses, and agents. Cryptographic avatars of verified real identities provide privacy with
   accountability. 15,000 tx/s through a highly parallel architecture, WASM smart contracts, 20s
   finality, permissionless, public and pseudonymous, run by nodes around the world for maximum
   resilience and decentralisation.
2. P-Layer - stablecoin and agentic payment chain: engineered for high-throughput, low-cost global
   settlement and truly programmable money, with native on- and off-ramping; 30,000 tx/s, finality
   <1s, byzantine security 45%; agentic transactions supported with verifiable, revocable
   permissions granted by their principals.
3. T-Layer - trading chain: a high-performance decentralized exchange, offering stablecoin swaps and
   perpetual futures in a predictable execution environment. 30,000 tx/s through native
   multithreaded operations, finality <1s, a node-permissioned overlay on the C-layer, private and
   accountable, native NASDAQ-like matching engine.

Use cases: global payments and payroll, remittances, embedded finance, microtransactions,
machine-to-machine commerce, on- and off-ramping, asset recovery (never lose your self custodied
crypto), bank accounts. Secure design and invisible cryptography means every transaction settles
instantly, every participant (human or agent) is verified and accountable, while every real-world
identity and transaction stays private.
